# Accuracy and teaching notes

The grouped learner-stage sentence on physical12 places vision and knowledge beside an accuracy figure; physical13 separately gives the vision ratio and knowledge passing standard. Do not teach a percentage-based vision score. Litter-study figures are attributed to the guide’s dated study and not asserted as current independently measured statistics. Licensing/renewal/currentness and source effective-date debts remain. [A01] [A02] [A03] [A04] [A05] [A06] [A07] [A08] [A09]
Memory cue, authored product policy: “Permit, restrictions, responsibility”. The cue retrieves complete cited rules and does not replace their conditions.
Terminology: Learner and intermediate describe separate stages; identification is different from driving permission.
Misconception to correct: A Louisiana identification card authorizes driving; the source explicitly separates identity evidence from driving privileges.
